question: Identify female clients born before 1960 who reside in districts with average salaries between 8000 and 9000, are not account owners, and have made at least one non-credit-card withdrawal (type = 'VYDAJ') in January 1996. Return the count of such distinct clients.

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.XCL_009) AS client_count
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp dp ON c.XCL_009 = dp.XCL_014
JOIN account a ON dp.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND c.XCL_011 < '1960-01-01'
  AND d.XCL_027 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
  AND dp.XCL_016 <> 'OWNER'
  AND t.XCL_049 = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.XCL_050 <> 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.XCL_048 LIKE '1996-01%'

FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp dp ON c.XCL_009 = dp.XCL_014
JOIN account a ON dp.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001

  AND t.XCL_050 <> 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.XCL_048 LIKE '1996-01%'
